name: Kusunoki Iroha
source:
Iroha is a second-year student who meets Tatsuya when the pair end up working on restoring a mural together. She's a gyaru with a wide friend group and is extremely bubbly. She's a little cheeky but is a kind girl who has a tendency to give everyone nicknames.
Iroha works part-time as a waitress at a local family restaurant and is also a very good cook. The one thing she struggles with is studying.
